game.name: Bhop pro
game.rules:
Time is calculated by the in-game timer.

# Video rules:

- Run has to be shown in the video
- The video has to be one single recording (no splices, no separate videos, no black bars on the screen or anything that closes part of the screen).
- The video feed has to be of acceptable quality. (the numbers on the timer must be distinguishable)
- The video should contain a table with the result.

Run can be recorded in offline mode or on a server. (In controversial situations, a timer on the server can help you determine if the finish has been reached)

Emulators are allowed but shown separately.

Changing controls type and sensitivity during the run is not allowed.

newsList.title: DPI Abuse Is Now Getting Under Control
newsList.body:
The speedrun.com leaderboards have been updated. We are now paying more attention to the screen setting (DPI) issue.

We have rejected many runs that abused this setting, making the competition in the main categories more equal and skill based. Some high DPI runs were left in the leaderboard as an e

categories.name: Daily Challenge
categories.rules:
You must complete the daily in-game event: complete 5 maps and get an item.

All maps in the challenge must be different. (If the game offers you an already completed map, re-roll it by going to the main menu, until the game offers you a new map)

The final time is the time combined of 5 completions (deaths are included too).

It is desirable for you to list the maps in run description to make the verification easier.

categories.name: Speedrun
categories.rules:
- You can't use any glitches in this category.

- From 23 April 2023, replay runs that claim to be at one of top 3 places will not be verified anymore. Old verified replay runs will remain in the leaderboard.

- (Applies for Android runners) Abusing excessive amounts of DPI (dots per inch) is not allowed. The maximum allowed limit is 600 DPI. If you're submitting a top 3 run, you must put your unedited full recording in the description, which shows your DPI and how you enter the game with it (If your speed gain is worse compared to other runs, that will not be necessary).
